objective: Keep entry coverage broad while reducing turnover: maintain a directional state and trade only when that state flips, rather than re-entering every H1/H4 event.

data_contract.source: attached XM closed OHLC CSV only

state_families.decision_clock: every fully closed H1 bar after 200 H1 bars warmup
state_families.desired_state: LONG if close > open, SHORT if close < open, unchanged on doji

state_families.decision_clock: every fully closed H1 bar after 200 H1 bars warmup
state_families.desired_state: SHORT if close > open, LONG if close < open, unchanged on doji

state_families.decision_clock: every fully closed H4 bar after 200 H4 bars warmup
state_families.desired_state: LONG if close > broker-day open, SHORT if close < broker-day open, unchanged on equality

state_families.decision_clock: every fully closed H4 bar after 200 H4 bars warmup
state_families.desired_state: SHORT if close > broker-day open, LONG if close < broker-day open, unchanged on equality

execution_state_machine.first_non_neutral_state: enter desired state at exact decision M1 open
execution_state_machine.same_state: hold without adding or resetting entry
execution_state_machine.state_flip: close current trade and reverse at the same exact decision M1 open
execution_state_machine.stopped_position: remain flat while desired state is unchanged; rearm only when desired state flips
execution_state_machine.decision_with_missing_exact_m1: ignore execution and retain prior executable state; no next-M1 fallback
execution_state_machine.end_of_data_open_trade: UNRESOLVED and excluded from PnL gates

risk_translations.stop: 4.00 x latest fully closed M15 ATR14 fixed from entry
risk_translations.exit: first stop touch or next executable desired-state flip
risk_translations.same_m1_rule: decision reversal occurs at M1 open before intrabar stop monitoring

risk_translations.stop: 2.00 x latest fully closed M15 ATR14 fixed from entry
risk_translations.exit: first stop touch or next executable desired-state flip
risk_translations.same_m1_rule: decision reversal occurs at M1 open before intrabar stop monitoring

family_robustness_gate: A family advances only when one risk translation passes all formal gates and at least one other risk translation has combined PF >= 1.00 and net >= 0.
selection_prohibitions: no post-result hour month year or volatility pruning
no immediate re-entry after a stop while the state remains unchanged
